_comment: Versioned scope registry (T5, design doc Sec 4/Sec 9). Scope boundaries are contested claims: entries are hypotheses, not ontology. Bump `version` on any change; unresolved raw strings logged by the resolver are the promotion queue for new aliases.

scopes.name: Egyptian Civilization
scopes.notes: A deliberately long-duration civilizational scope for the historical-corpus pilot; narrower dynastic scopes remain valid focal subjects.

scopes.notes: A geographic visualization parent, not a claim that the region has one homogeneous civilization.

scopes.notes: Deliberately no civilization parent: Russia-as-Western is contested.

scopes.notes: Spans dynastic breaks per the design doc's default hypothesis (Sec 9).

scopes.name: Communist Party of China
scopes.notes: The party and the wider communist movement are not identical; movement aliases are retained as a reviewable registry hypothesis for coarse historical extraction.
